# ML-14: Responsible ML (Fairness, Interpretability and Robustness) (Tier 3)

**Subtrack:** Machine Learning Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Fairness metrics and trade-offs, explainability methods and their limits, adversarial and distributional robustness, model cards.

**Tier note:** Tier 1 has one assessment, on measuring group-level error disparities and reading a model card. Fairness interventions and interpretability trade-offs need independent judgement and belong at Tiers 2 and 3.
